cohort: Preterm infants less than 37 weeks gestation admitted to the Department of Pediatrics, Sri Krishna Medical College and Hospital, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India.
finding: Delayed cord clamping (DCC) was associated with a significant reduction in intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) and early red blood cell transfusions in preterm infants.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2250g in the immediate cord clamping group and 2325g in the delayed cord clamping group.
